assets.name: buy
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Reference image: supplied four-panel ADURE moodboard. Create ONE standalone portrait photograph, 1024x1536, matching closely the FIRST (leftmost BUY) panel: luxury Abu Dhabi waterfront apartment terrace, cream sofa and round stone table, glass railing, olive tree, Etihad Towers skyline across blue water. Preserve the reference panel's composition, warm natural light, materials and subdued premium editorial photography. Fill the entire canvas with that ONE scene only. Remove ALL typography, words, logos, labels, underlines, watermarks and panel dividers, including all lettering on walls and uniforms. No collage, no UI, no baked gradient. This is the clean photographic asset for the buy website card.
